stderr_matches: \[kuna --jobs\] structsynth: \d+ decompile\(s\) of the functions with synthesized structures again, with the serial names

notes: A serial decompile-all of this fixture synthesizes five struct_N. The workers record every structure-ledger lookup, the parent replays them in target order, and the functions that synthesized anything are decompiled again with the serial names, so all five reach the document under the names --jobs 1 gives them (the kuna-cli integration test compares the documents byte for byte).
